title: Anthropic plans to put 5% of its shares in a Public Benefit Fund for AI's economic impacts
summary: Anthropic said it will commit 5% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund LLC to address AI's economic and labour impacts, subject to stockholder approval; the board may add 2% for each 50% rise in value. With founder pledges, about 20% of shares would go to the public good.
reason: A large equity commitment from a frontier lab to share the windfall; still an announcement pending approval, so T2 signal.

title: Anthropic study: entry-level share of its technical hires fell from 27% to 9%
summary: Anthropic's research on its own workforce found entry-level workers fell from 27% to 9% of technical hires since early 2025, as work shifted toward supervising agents.
reason: Measured data show AI shrinking entry-level hiring, but only at one firm, so T1.

title: DeepSeek releases open-weight V4.1-Flash-1017 with an 8x smaller KV cache
summary: DeepSeek published V4.1-Flash-1017 open weights on Hugging Face. It reports better reasoning, coding, agentic and visual benchmarks and a KV cache of 890 bytes per token, about 1/8 of V4-Flash.
reason: An incremental update to the already-scored V4.1 Flash; open weights spread capability; benchmarks are self-reported, so T1.

title: Meta details Prometheus gigawatt-scale supercluster, scaling toward ~1M GPUs
summary: A Meta engineering post describes Prometheus, a gigawatt-scale supercluster that trains its Muse models, with plans to scale toward roughly one million GPUs.
reason: A large compute build-out, but described by Meta itself and partly a plan, so a small F1 step.
